statement: Linux and SDL send rumble and subcommands via output report 0x01, and rumble-only via output report 0x10. The community report layout describes an incrementing packet nibble and two rumble words before subcommand ID/arguments, with input 0x21 returning the command ID and ACK type. Linux waits for matching replies. These establish candidate framing and consumer expectations, not a physically captured Pro reply matrix.
